text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Bravo! I have recognized your insatiable pursuit of ever greater speed!

text_block_list.name: Director Akikawa
text_block_list.text: See that you continue your endeavors in earnest! I now take my leave!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She's apparently pleased with the way we're conducting our practice sessions.
